title: CEC to hold 5 televised forums, debates on nuclear referendum
summary: Taipei, Sept. 18 (CNA) Five televised forums or debates on a referendum seeking to abolish Taiwan's policy of creating a "nuclear-free homeland" will begin on Nov. 12, the Central Election Commission (CEC) announced on Friday.

title: President Lai attends eastern Taiwan quake drill observed by 18 countries
summary: Taipei, Sept. 18 (CNA) President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) on Friday inspected a large-scale earthquake disaster response drill in eastern Taiwan, attended by representatives from 18 countries and more than 150 international search-and-rescue and medical personnel.

title: New Taiwan-Matsu cable boosts communications resilience: Premier
summary: Taipei, Sept. 18 (CNA) Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) on Friday launched a new Taiwan-Matsu subsea cable, calling it part of the government's "preemptive preparations" to bolster communications resilience.

title: KMT Changhua County council speaker held in vote-buying probe
summary: Taipei, Sept. 17 (CNA) Changhua County Council Speaker Hsieh Dien-lin (謝典霖) and four others, including his parents, were taken into custody Thursday in connection with a June banquet that authorities allege constituted vote-buying.

title: U.S. lawmaker Kim urges Washington to support Taiwan's IMF membership
summary: Taipei, Sept. 17 (CNA) United States Representative Young Kim on Tuesday urged Washington to support Taiwan's admission to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and encourage Taipei to apply as soon as possible.

title: MOFA thanks European Parliament for recognition of Taiwan's resilience
summary: Taipei, Sept. 17 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Wednesday expressed gratitude for the European Parliament's recognition of Taiwan's resilience and technological strengths in its report titled "Findings and Recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield (EUDS)."
